# MESH — Medinah English Students Hub

> MESH is a community question-and-answer site and guide archive for English-speaking international students in Madinah (Medina), Saudi Arabia — including students of the Islamic University of Madinah. Members ask and answer practical questions about arriving, settling, studying and eventually leaving, and experienced students (mandoobs) publish longer guides. Everything is peer knowledge shared from personal experience — helpful and current, but not official guidance. The site also hosts Nabawi Duroos, a schedule of Islamic lessons (duroos) at Madinah masjids with alerts for cancellations and changes.

## Main

- [MESH home — recent questions and categories](https://medinahub.org/): The front page of the community.
- [Nabawi Duroos — lesson schedules](https://medinahub.org/duroos): Weekly duroos schedules for Masjid Nabawi, Masjid Quba, the Islamic University and other Madinah masjids, with cancellation and change alerts.
- [Resources — guides and walkthroughs](https://medinahub.org/resources): Longer articles written by experienced students.
- [Browse all questions](https://medinahub.org/browse): Every discussion, searchable and filterable by category.
